measures.definition: Accumulated movement energy used during the expedition.
measures.limitation: Low consumption can also mean inactivity or early termination.

measures.definition: At each decision with a known return route, battery minus the cheapest offered return-route energy estimate. Compare with returnReserveEnergy.
measures.limitation: Unavailable without a known return route. Estimates assume immediate departure and currently known hazards; this is not a safety guarantee.

measures.unit: new terrain cells per simulated minute
measures.definition: Distinct terrain cells first observed after start divided by elapsed expedition minutes.
measures.limitation: Unavailable at zero elapsed time. Depends on sensor range and terrain, and does not measure scientific value.

measures.definition: Delivered sample count divided by delivered plus onboard sample count.
measures.limitation: Unavailable before any collection. Ignores sample relevance and uncollected opportunities.

measures.definition: Science score credited at base under the fixed objective and rubric.
measures.limitation: Depends on the objective and discovered opportunities. Undelivered cargo earns no credit; this is an outcome, not model confidence.
